_comment: Network figures for /network/ (featureFlags.networkStats + networkCoverageMap). A metric renders only when value is a positive integer, the metric AND the file are approvedForPublication, and verifiedAt + source are set. Unknown = null (the metric is hidden, never shown as 0 or a dash). Generate values with tools/compute_network_stats.py from a canonical property export, then have the owner approve. Never hand-type estimates here.

definitions.directProperties: Properties with an active direct commercial agreement with KabuK Exchange. A direct contract does not mean a direct technical connection; inventory obtained through a connectivity partner, wholesaler or other supplier is not counted here unless the property also holds a direct agreement.
definitions.directCountries: Countries or markets with at least one directly contracted property.
definitions.availableProperties: Unique, currently bookable properties across all enabled supply sources (direct and connected), counted once using canonical property mapping.
definitions.countriesCovered: Countries or markets with at least one currently bookable property from any enabled supply source.

coverage._comment: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes. 'direct' = markets with directly contracted properties. 'connected' = markets with bookable inventory ONLY through connected suppliers (do not repeat direct markets here). Coverage does not imply a direct commercial relationship.
